name: dcerecedo-skills
description: dcerecedo's Claude Code skills. explain-flow: explains the control flow behind the current issue with linked UML diagrams and domain-language prose, in a pane and an offline browser view.

editorUrl.title: Editor link template
editorUrl.description: Link opened for a code reference. Placeholders: {abs} absolute path, {path} repo-relative path, {line} line number.

outputDir.title: Output folder
outputDir.description: Where explanations (.json and .html) are written, relative to the repo root.

openBrowser.title: Open browser view automatically
openBrowser.description: Open the HTML view in the browser after each explanation is rendered.

browserCommand.title: Browser open command
browserCommand.description: Command that opens a file in the browser; the file path is appended.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Interpreter for the Python/Django resolver (e.g. .venv/bin/python). Only the standard library is needed.
